newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 27.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on the front page of its Wednesday edition: - U.S. President Bill Clinton wants Congress to restore about one quarter of the $55 billion in spending that would otherwise be saved by the new welfare law over the next six years.
- Large mutual fund companies say cash flows into stock funds in November have already surpassed last month's flows.
- The Yugoslavian city of Nis has turned against the Belgrade government after it cancelled the opposition's victory in local elections.
- Japanese investors are increasingly reluctant to invest overseas.
- Walt Disney Co intends to release a film on the life of the Dalai Lama despite warnings from China.
- A former U.S. prosecutor committed suicide after fleeing to avoid a prison term for tax fraud, embezzlement and abuse of power.
